output.summary: An annual leaf vegetable native from the Mediterranean to Siberia, lettuce has leaves ranging from dense heads to loose, frilly forms in many colors. Leaves are usually eaten raw in salads, though they also appear in sandwiches, wraps and soups; some varieties provide edible stems or seeds pressed for cooking oil.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are eaten raw or cooked and used in salads, sandwiches, wraps and soups; some varieties provide edible stems or seeds pressed for cooking oil.
